items.text:
SO hard to get in to!
I want to love this game, but I keep dying for reasons I don't understand. Alarms go off, no blinkers anywhere, without explanation. I've had doors .. fail? .. without explanation or any ability to repair.
Its space.. use freakin' obvious indicator lights, there may not be an atmosphere in an emergency!
items.text_zh:
太难上手了！
我想爱上这款游戏，但我总是因为一些我不明白的原因而死。警报响了，到处都没有指示灯，毫无解释。我遇到过门……失灵？……没有任何解释，也没法修。
这是太空啊……用他妈明显的指示灯啊，紧急情况下可能根本没有大气！

observations.description: 门出现故障且无法修复，无解释。
observations.evidence: I've had doors .. fail? .. without explanation or any ability to repair
observations.evidence_zh: 我遇到过门..失灵？..没有任何解释，也没有任何修理的办法
